editorial:
Imagine waking up and finding out you have a death sentence because of a workplace accident. That is exactly what happens to the main guy in this story. He is just a regular worker at a nuclear plant who gets hit with a lethal dose of radiation. Since he knows he is dying and his family will be left with nothing, he does something crazy. He steals plutonium and tries to sell it in the shady parts of Moscow. To make things even messier, he has to team up with a low-level criminal who has no idea what he is doing. The whole vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure of a man running out of time.

You will really love how the acting feels real and raw. The chemistry between the desperate worker and the clumsy crook adds a bit of weird energy to a very sad situation. While the pacing is a bit slow in some spots, the stress of the ticking clock keeps you interested. If you enjoy stories about people pushed to their limits, you should definitely check this out. You can grab it as a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection or look for it to rent on Apple TV for a clear, high-quality picture.
endingExplained: In the end, the main character's health gets worse as the radiation takes over his body. He manages to navigate the dangerous black market and sells the plutonium, but it is a bittersweet win. He gets the money he needs to make sure his family is taken care of after he is gone. He eventually passes away, knowing his kids are safe, which gives the sad story a small bit of peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty dramas about survival and family sacrifice.
